term: demonstrative foundation and noncircular empirical argument
definition: NoDemonstration denies the explicitly supplied demonstration proposition. It does not deny every epistemic entitlement, causal reality, or successful prediction. UnprovedExtension denies the supplied reason-based proof of extending the record. The parameters stand for the historical account of reasoning and are not Lean theorem provability.
note: Bounded analytical vocabulary for #269. This definition fixes test semantics; source endorsement or normative adequacy is not established by naming it.
